address: 2F, Hilton, 88 Wenxue Road, Jiaojiang, Taizhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: This F&B outlet in an upmarket hotel specialises in Taizhou cuisine, especially local seafood. First make your pick from the live fish tank and display trays. The kitchen, helmed by a chef with 20+ years’ experience, then deftly gets to work to showcase each ingredient’s natural seafood flavours. Their signature jelly-like mud crab is steamed and iced repeatedly until half-cooked before marinated; the creamy and gelatinous roe and meat are addictive.
